methodology.scope: One local host, real native services and PostgreSQL in a container VM; no production capacity claim
methodology.mix: All requests critical; 60% orders, 20% catalog, 20% inventory; no HTTP priority cohorts in this experiment
methodology.policy: Default tenant share/hard cap 2, borrowed ceiling 4 or 12; demand window 500ms, registry 32, idle expiry 2s; missing/overflow reject
methodology.capacity: Service max 12, critical reservation 4, adaptive minimum 5/initial 12; each SQL pool 4
methodology.traffic: Scheduled Go open-loop arrivals, no application retries, timeout 3s, max 4096 generator requests in flight
methodology.return_time: First successful response completion after ordinary traffic restarts; includes waiting until the first offered request
methodology.sampling: 250ms; pool cleanup measured after each phase before the next; control calls excluded
methodology.limits: Borrowing is not preemption or a latency guarantee; compare total throughput, ordinary p95 and rejection rates together
